definition: Generating images as next-token prediction over discrete visual tokens from a VQ tokenizer, the pre-diffusion paradigm revived by unified any-to-any models that emit text and image tokens from one transformer.
details: Generating images as next-token prediction over discrete visual tokens from a VQ tokenizer, the pre-diffusion paradigm revived by unified any-to-any models that emit text and image tokens from one transformer. The architectural bet that one autoregressive backbone can own all modalities.
